header.scoreTable: Exact +(10+call) / missed -(10+call). A Dash Call (0) is ±23; Risk (the highest call) doubles. Over and under lose the same.

hint.estimationBid: Counted from the high cards in your hand.
hint.estimationDashCall: No strength here — a Dash Call (0) pays better.
hint.estimationAvoidRestricted: Your estimate is the barred number, so this shifts by one.
hint.estimationWinTrick: You are short of your call — go for this trick.
hint.estimationDuck: You already have your call — avoid taking more.

tutorial.score: You score **only for an exact call**. One short and five over lose the same, so a bigger call is a bigger bet.
tutorial.call: Call the tricks you expect to take. **A Dash Call (0) is ±23** and the highest call (Risk) doubles. Whoever calls last may not make the total 13.
tutorial.seats: Each seat's call, tricks taken and running total. Watch whether an opponent is about to make their call.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Legal cards get a green ring. Once you have your call, the play is to duck everything else.
